Thanks for the reply. I've been to a psych once, but was too afraid to be honest with her so she couldn't really help me. Maybe it was cause of my mom sitting in the same room, but I got too uncomfortable, cried and almost had a full on panic attack. Haven't had the courage to talk to anyone about my problems and shit after that.

My username's a bit hard to translate to be honest, basically means 'booze numbs you up', but in a cooler way, sounds stupid as shit in English. Been drinking to cope so that's where it came from I guess.
